what_changes: The 100 ms transient rate cap now runs against the burst-aware switch rule and the step-level host gate instead of the completed-round gate; suspicion is expected early, but the switch-side symptom clears before enough slow steps complete while it is active.
expected: The burst-aware rule may raise suspicion during the transient, the step gate refuses to confirm because the degraded-burst symptom clears, no recovery commits, and throughput retention stays near the fault-free baseline.
